Actively collaborated with product stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather requirements, propose solutions, and ensure high-quality delivery aligned with best coding practices.

Led the deployment and production support activities, ensuring reliable and secure operation of critical fintech services.

,Core Java 1.7,SOL Server,RestEasy Jar for REST API, JSP and Servlet for Web,HTML,CSS,JOuery.

BEC Kuwait Project ( Year : 2021 - 2022 )

° Oversaw complete SDLC lifecycle for assigned modules — from user communication, estimation, development, and testing to

deployment and production support.

Provided proactive 2nd and 3rd level production support, collaborating with global teams to ensure platform stability and scalability.

Developed REST APIs for money transfer and travel money services, supporting 5+ client systems (App, Kiosk, Web Portal).

Core Java 1.8,SQL Server,RestEasy Jar for REST API, JSP and Servlet for Web,HTML,CSS,JOuery



ICICI Bank Project (Year : 2022 - 2023)

Contributed to the Pre-Fund module development, focusing on backend logic implementation and integration with existing banking systems.

a Developed and enhanced reporting functionality, enabling accurate and efficient data extraction and presentation for business users.

Collaborated with senior developers and business analysts to understand requirements and deliver solutions aligning with financial and compliance standards.

Research and Development: Microservices Migration Project (Year : 2023 - 2024)

Conducted in-depth analysis of the existing monolithic codebase, studying legacy code and database structures to identify migration opportunities.

a Bifurcated the legacy codebase into well-defined, modular services, significantly improving scalability, modularity, and maintainability.

Design & Development of Product

Engaged in full SDLC activities, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, and testing.

Led the design and development of core product components such as retirement benefit calculation, income/loss distribution, and document management within the Wealth Management System.

Demonstrated expertise in Oracle databases, writing complex SQL queries to support system functionality.

Participated in test case reviews and code reviews to maintain high coding standards.

Actively contributed to Project Status Report (PSR) meetings, providing updates on ongoing activities and discussing forthcoming enhancements.

Technical & Functional Training

Delivered comprehensive training sessions to the implementation team on various system functionalities and configurations.

management.
